name: 1N4001
description: Lowest-voltage member of the ubiquitous 1N400x general-purpose silicon rectifier family, 50V / 1A average in DO-41. Mains/low-frequency rectification, freewheeling clamps, and reverse-polarity protection.

extra.Rth(JA): 50 C/W typ (9.5mm lead length, PCB mounted)

typical_application: Bridge/half-wave rectification in linear supplies; freewheel diode across relays and inductive loads.
gotchas: the printed band marks the CATHODE, not the anode
slow PN junction (no trr spec); not for switching converters above a few kHz - use a fast or Schottky diode there
1N4001 through 1N4007 are physically identical, differing only in reverse voltage; do not assume an unmarked one is the high-voltage grade
rated 1A average, not 1A continuous into all conditions; derate with temperature
